ثَاغٍ [part. n. of ثَغَى: and hence, ―
-b2- ] A sheep or goat [&c.]; (TA;) as also [its fem.] ثَاغِيَةٌ. (S, K, TA.) You say, مَالَهُ ثَاغٍ وَلَا رَاغٍ (TA) and مَا لَهُ ثَاغِيَةٌ وَلَا رَاغِيةٌ (S, TA) He has not a sheep or goat, nor a camel: (S, TA:) or مَا لَهُ رَاغِيَةٌ وَلَا ثَاغِيَةٌ he has not a she-camel nor a sheep or goat. (Har p. 333.) And مَا بِالدَّارِ ثَاغٍ وَلَا رَاغٍ (assumed tropical:) There is not in the house any one. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
